title: Skin Care After Swimming: A 10-Minute Routine for Chlorine
ex: What to do before and after a swim: rinse off chlorine, a gentle wash, moisturiser on damp skin, sunscreen at outdoor pools and a swim-day night routine.
rt: Skin Care After Swimming: Chlorine Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care after swimming: rinse off chlorine, cleanse gently and moisturise on damp skin. Before, after and night steps for Indian pools and strong sun.
quick: After swimming, rinse off pool water within a few minutes, wash with a gentle cleanser in lukewarm water, and moisturise while skin is still slightly damp. At outdoor pools, use water-resistant SPF 30+ sunscreen and reapply after the swim.
facts: Rinse off chlorine soon after you get out
Moisturise within a few minutes on damp skin
Sunscreen washes off; reapply after outdoor swims
See a doctor for a rash or bumps after every swim
